item.text: The campaign is live with all three approved posts, a US$50 daily budget and a US$200 lifetime cap. It targets iOS users worldwide, excludes Russia and Belarus, and ends at midnight after January 6 Singapore time. I’ve left language targeting open to match your localized coverage.

At the first check, X reports US$24.89 spent, 71,974 impressions and 63 link clicks—about US$0.40 per click. Spending is on pace, and the posts have similar click costs, so I’m keeping all three running.
Day one has ended in Singapore. Reported totals are US$47.93 spent, 159,714 impressions and 129 link clicks, averaging US$0.37 per click. Delivery remains on budget; I’ll keep the current settings.
The day-two midday check shows US$75.51 spent and 196 link clicks. Click costs remain close across the three posts, with no clear winner yet. I’m continuing the test at the current pace.

At the halfway point, reported totals are US$98.36 spent, 322,274 impressions and 257 link clicks. The campaign is tracking close to the planned US$100 for two days, with an average click cost of US$0.38.
The day-three midday check shows US$124.08 spent and 320 link clicks, averaging US$0.39 per click. Spending and click costs remain steady, so I’m holding the current settings.

Three days are complete: US$149.16 spent and 393 link clicks. The deadline-focused third post has generated the most clicks, though click costs are still similar across all three. I’ll keep them running through the final day under the US$200 cap.
At midday on the final day, X reports US$171.07 spent, 556,571 impressions and 447 link clicks. The campaign remains within budget and is scheduled to stop at the offer deadline tonight.
The campaign has ended at midnight Singapore time, and I’ve confirmed it can no longer serve. I’ll check reporting once more in an hour before sending the recap.

The January 3–6 campaign is complete and stopped on schedule, Singapore time.

- **Spend:** US$199.27 of US$200
- **Impressions:** 652,867
- **Link clicks:** 520
- **Average cost per link click:** US$0.38

Used only your three approved posts, targeting iOS users and excluding Russia and Belarus. Trial starts remain measured on your side; X couldn’t report them.
